look.why: A soft tropical coastal-jungle mint green that evokes Ujung Kulon's rainforest and highlights the armor-plated skin folds.

size.measure: lip to tail tip, about 3.5 m (body 3.1–3.2 m plus 60–70 cm tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Dense lowland tropical rainforests, coastal floodplains and mud wallows in Ujung Kulon National Park, West Java.

diet.text: Shoots, twigs, young foliage and fallen forest fruits plucked with its pointed prehensile upper lip.

facts.text: One of the rarest large mammals on Earth, with the entire wild population surviving in Ujung Kulon National Park in Java, Indonesia.
Deep skin folds give it a riveted armor-plated appearance, and only males grow a single horn (usually under 25 cm).

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis dataran rendah, dataran banjir pesisir, dan kubangan lumpur di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Jawa Barat.
id.diet: Tunas, ranting muda, dedaunan, dan buah hutan yang dipetik menggunakan bibir atasnya yang runcing dan lentur.
facts: Salah satu mamalia besar paling langka di Bumi; seluruh populasi liarnya bertahan hidup di Taman Nasional Ujung Kulon, Indonesia.
Lipatan kulitnya yang dalam tampak seperti baju zirah berlapis, dan hanya pejantan yang menumbuhkan satu cula (biasanya di bawah 25 cm).
